title: Decomposing Functions into Given Building Blocks (Set I)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Let f(x) = x - 3, g(x) = sqrt(x), h(x) = x^3, and j(x) = 2x. Express each of the following functions as a composition involving one or more of f, g, h, and j: (a) y = sqrt(x) - 3, (b) y = 2*sqrt(x), (c) y = x^(1/4), (d) y = 4x, (e) y = sqrt((x - 3)^3), and (f) y = (2x - 6)^3.
finalAnswer: \text{(a) } (f \circ g)(x),\quad \text{(b) } (j \circ g)(x),\quad \text{(c) } (g \circ g)(x),\quad \text{(d) } (j \circ j)(x),\quad \text{(e) } (g \circ h \circ f)(x),\quad \text{(f) } (h \circ j \circ f)(x)

steps.title: Decompose the Two-Step Expressions in Parts (a) and (b)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(a) } y &= \sqrt{x} - 3 = g(x) - 3 = f(g(x)) = (f \circ g)(x) \\ \text{(b) } y &= 2\sqrt{x} = 2g(x) = j(g(x)) = (j \circ g)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: In (a), first take the square root via g(x) = sqrt(x), then subtract 3 via f. In (b), first take the square root via g(x) = sqrt(x), then double the result via j(x) = 2x.
steps.why: Identifying the order of operations (inner operation first, outer operation last) directly determines the composition order.

steps.title: Decompose the Self-Compositions in Parts (c) and (d)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(c) } y &= x^{1/4} = \sqrt{\sqrt{x}} = g(g(x)) = (g \circ g)(x) \\ \text{(d) } y &= 4x = 2(2x) = j(j(x)) = (j \circ j)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: By exponent laws, x^(1/4) = (x^(1/2))^(1/2) is two successive square roots g(g(x)), while 4x = 2(2x) is two successive doublings j(j(x)).
steps.why: Repeated application of power or scaling functions multiplies their exponents or scale factors.

steps.title: Decompose the Three-Step Expressions in Parts (e) and (f)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(e) } y &= \sqrt{(x - 3)^3} = \sqrt{h(f(x))} = g(h(f(x))) = (g \circ h \circ f)(x) \\ \text{(f) } y &= (2x - 6)^3 = (2(x - 3))^3 = (j(f(x)))^3 = h(j(f(x))) = (h \circ j \circ f)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: In (e), subtract 3 (f), cube the result (h), and take the square root (g). In (f), factor 2x - 6 as 2(x - 3) = j(f(x)) and then cube via h.
steps.why: Factoring 2x - 6 = 2(x - 3) expresses the inner linear map as the composition j o f.
